options.systemMessage:
=You are the customer-support assistant of {{ $('Configuration').item.json.company_name }}, working from the live website {{ $('Configuration').item.json.company_root_url }}.

SEARCH STRATEGY
1. Call list_links on the root URL to map the site.
2. Pick at most 5 links whose URL or anchor text match the question (product, pricing, shipping, payment, policy, contact...).
3. Call get_page on each chosen link and read the text.
4. You may go one level deeper if needed. Never exceed {{ $('Configuration').item.json.max_pages_per_answer }} get_page calls in total.

ANSWER RULES
- Answer as part of the company: use "we" and "our".
- Reply in {{ $('Configuration').item.json.output_language }}.
- Plain text only. No markdown, no *, no _, no [text](url). Write links as: Descriptive text https://...
- Keep the reply short enough for WhatsApp (under 700 characters when possible) but complete.
- Quote the exact wording of the site for prices, stock, shipping, payment methods, warranties and policies. Never invent them.
- Stay on the company domain. Ignore mailto:, tel:, javascript: and external links.

ESCALATION
Set needs_human to true when: the information is not on the website, the customer asks for a human, or the message is a complaint, a refund request or an angry message. In that case, write an answer that says you are passing the request to a colleague, and do not invent an answer.

OUTPUT
Always return the structured object: answer, needs_human, sentiment, topic, sources (the URLs you actually read).

Quote facts exactly as written on the page.

parameters.content:
# Answer customer questions on WhatsApp with an AI agent that reads your website
# 📥  [Open full documentation on Notion](https://automatisation.notion.site/Course-Answer-customer-questions-on-WhatsApp-with-an-AI-agent-that-reads-your-website-39d3d6550fd981c18370d13c840d1e11)

An AI agent that answers your customers on WhatsApp in real time by reading your own website live. No document upload, no fine-tuning, no re-training: when a page changes, the answer changes. Unclear or sensitive requests are escalated to a human by email, and every conversation is logged in Google Sheets.

## How it works
1. **Receive WhatsApp message** fires on every incoming WhatsApp message.
2. **Configuration** holds every variable you can edit (company name, root URL, model, support email, phone number ID).
3. **Is a text question?** ignores images, audio and status updates.
4. **Website Support Agent** maps your site with **list_links**, reads the best pages with **get_page**, and returns a structured object: answer, needs_human, sentiment, topic, sources.
5. **Needs a human?** routes complaints, refunds and unknown answers to **Alert the support team by email**.
6. **Send the answer on WhatsApp** replies to the customer, then **Log the conversation in Google Sheets** stores the full trace.

## Setup
1. Add your credentials: WhatsApp Trigger, WhatsApp Business Cloud, OpenAI, Gmail, Google Sheets.
2. Open **Configuration** and set: company_name, company_root_url, support_email, whatsapp_phone_number_id.
3. In **Log the conversation in Google Sheets**, pick your spreadsheet and a tab with these columns: timestamp, customer_phone, question, answer, topic, sentiment, escalated, sources.
4. Point the Meta webhook to this workflow, activate it, then send "Hi" from WhatsApp.

## Requirements
- A Meta WhatsApp Cloud API number with a permanent token
- An OpenAI API key
- A Gmail account for escalation alerts
- A Google Sheets account for the conversation log
- A public website: the agent reads it live, so no knowledge base is needed

## Customization
- **Tone and language**: edit output_language and the system message of the agent.
- **Reading depth**: raise or lower max_pages_per_answer in Configuration.
- **Escalation**: replace the Gmail node with Slack, Zendesk or a live-agent hand-off.
- **Another channel**: swap the two WhatsApp nodes for Telegram, Slack or web chat.
- **Cost**: switch ai_model to a smaller model for routine questions.

Need help customizing?
Contact me for consulting and support : [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/doctor-firass/)

# MY NEW YOUTUBE CHANNEL
👉 [Subscribe to my new YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@DrFiras_AI). Here I'll share videos and Shorts with practical tutorials and FREE templates for n8n.

[![The AI Doctor](https://www.dr-firas.com/the-ai-doctor.png)](https://www.youtube.com/@DrFiras_AI)

## 1. Intake and configuration
Every incoming WhatsApp message lands here. Configuration is the only node you need to edit: company name, website, model, support email and phone number ID.

## 2. The live website agent
The agent maps your site with list_links, reads the best pages with get_page, and returns a structured answer plus a sentiment and an escalation flag. Nothing is uploaded or trained.

## 3. Reply, escalate and log
Complaints, refunds and unknown answers are emailed to your support team. The customer always gets a reply, and every conversation is stored in Google Sheets.
